titleZh: AI 自动化编码，把开发者整体上移到「资深级」工作
titleEn: Andrew Ng on developers moving up to senior-level work (The Batch #362)
author: Andrew Ng
authorTitle: DeepLearning.AI 创始人、AI Fund 管理合伙人、斯坦福大学兼职教授（The Batch 每周信）
summary: Andrew Ng：AI 自动化编码不消灭岗位，而是把从业者「上移」到资深工作、全栈化。
keyPoints: **AI 把人上移到高层工作**：编码被自动化后，人转向架构决策、需求界定——这是廉价编码的互补品，需求反升。
**全栈化是跨领域统一现象**：专精开发者变全栈、窄口径营销变端到端统筹、分工招聘变全周期。
**边界：不适用所有岗位**：IC 轨道资深意味着更专精，AI 影响取决于「锯齿状前沿」在该维度推进的快慢。
insight: 人才培养该从「教会写代码」转向「教会做架构决策与需求界定」，接住上移红利。

bilingual.en: As AI increasingly automates coding, it frees up developers to spend time on high-level software development tasks traditionally reserved for senior engineers, like deciding on technical architecture and participating in scoping product requirements. Demand for this type of work is growing, since it is an economic complement to coding, which is becoming cheaper. This is why I'm confident there will be rising demand for broad AI engineering skills. I see a similar pattern starting to emerge in other AI-influenced fields as well, and am cautiously optimistic — contrary to predictions of a "jobpocalypse" — that AI will generally increase demand for people with the right skills.
bilingual.zh: 随着 AI 越来越多地自动化编码，它把开发者解放出来，去做那些传统上只属于资深工程师的高层软件开发工作——比如决定技术架构、参与界定产品需求范围。这类工作的需求正在增长，因为它是「正变得越来越便宜的编码」的经济互补品。这就是为什么我有信心：对广义 AI 工程技能的需求会持续上升。我在其他受 AI 影响的领域也看到类似模式开始浮现，因此我谨慎乐观——与「就业末日（jobpocalypse）」的预测相反——AI 总体上会增加对拥有正确技能的人的需求。

bilingual.en: Take marketing. AI is helpful for drafting and editing marketing copy, gathering market data, and performing very basic data analysis. (In my experience, analyses by even frontier models are frequently wrong. So do use AI to help with your data-science tasks, but don't blindly trust its confidently stated conclusions!) This frees up marketers to spend more time on higher-level tasks. I'm seeing that rather than specializing in narrow marketing roles like social media marketer or copy editor, AI-native marketers are rising up to help coordinate broader marketing campaigns end-to-end, from conception to multi-threaded execution to analyzing lessons learned.
bilingual.zh: 以营销为例。AI 能帮忙起草和编辑营销文案、收集市场数据、做非常基础的数据分析。（以我的经验，即便是前沿模型做的分析也经常出错。所以尽管用 AI 辅助你的数据科学任务，但不要盲信它自信满满给出的结论！）这把营销人解放出来，去花更多时间在更高层的任务上。我看到的是：AI 原生的营销人不再专精于社媒营销、文案编辑这类窄口径角色，而是上移去端到端统筹更大的营销活动——从构思、到多线并行执行、到复盘经验教训。

bilingual.en: Just as AI is turning many specialized developers (like frontend, backend, mobile, etc.) into full-stack developers, I am seeing early signs that it is turning many more marketers into full-stack marketers.
bilingual.zh: 正如 AI 正在把许多专精开发者（前端、后端、移动端等）变成全栈开发者一样，我看到早期迹象：它正在把更多营销人变成「全栈营销人」。

bilingual.en: Or take recruiting. Some companies have separate roles for sourcer (who finds candidates online), coordinator (who handles scheduling) and recruiter (who runs the hiring process). But sourcing is increasingly automated, and coordination also partially automated. As a consequence, I'm seeing more AI-native recruiters run the full-cycle themselves, doing all of the above.
bilingual.zh: 再看招聘。有些公司把角色拆得很细：sourcer（在线上找候选人）、coordinator（安排面试日程）、recruiter（跑招聘流程）。但寻源正被日益自动化，协调也部分自动化了。结果是，我看到越来越多 AI 原生的招聘人自己跑完整个全周期，把上面这些活全做了。

bilingual.en: As AI enters more fields, I expect more people to start to play "full-stack" or "full-cycle" roles within their disciplines, meaning they will play broader roles that integrate traditionally separate roles. This lets individuals do more, and I believe it will ultimately lead to increased demand for skills as well as higher pay.
bilingual.zh: 随着 AI 进入更多领域，我预计会有更多人开始在自己的学科内扮演「全栈」或「全周期」角色——即扮演整合了传统上彼此分立角色的更宽职能。这让个体能做更多事，而且我相信这最终会带来对技能的更高需求，以及更高的薪酬。

bilingual.en: The broader pattern is this: In many job roles, as you rise in seniority, you become better at managing integration complexity — weaving together many disparate work streams like frontend, backend and data engineering to form a greater whole. As AI automates certain parts of one's work — usually the more verifiable parts — it creates more room for individuals to play broader roles.
bilingual.zh: 更普遍的规律是：在许多岗位上，随着资历上升，你会越来越擅长管理「集成复杂度」——把前端、后端、数据工程等许多分散的工作流编织成一个更大的整体。当 AI 自动化掉工作中的某些部分——通常是更可验证的那些部分——它就为个体扮演更宽的角色腾出了空间。

bilingual.en: This pattern is not applicable to all job roles. In some, rising in seniority means increasing specialization. This corresponds loosely to people progressing in the IC (individual contributor) career track rather than the managerial/tech lead track. For example, a machine learning engineer acquiring extremely deep understanding of a technical niche, a financial expert growing from a generalist finance analyst to a specialist in an important sector (such as auditing cross-border deals), or a medical doctor developing deep expertise in just one medical condition. In many, but not all, such areas, I expect the demand for human skill to grow, but AI's impact on any specialty will depend on how rapidly AI's jagged frontier advances along that dimension.
bilingual.zh: 这个模式并不适用于所有岗位。在有些岗位上，资历上升意味着日益专精。这大致对应走 IC（个人贡献者）职业轨道、而非管理/技术负责人轨道的人。例如：对某个技术细分领域获得极深理解的机器学习工程师；从通才金融分析师成长为某个重要领域（如跨境交易审计）专家的金融人士；或者专注深耕单一疾病的医生。在许多（但非全部）这类领域，我预计对人类技能的需求会增长，但 AI 对任何一个专精方向的影响，取决于 AI 的「锯齿状前沿」沿那个维度推进得有多快。

bilingual.en: Until then, I invite you to consider: Back in 2022, what tasks would your teammates have done? Those were likely complements to what you are doing. So if you are able to use AI to do more of those tasks yourself — which might require learning new skills — it could be one path to you becoming more effective with AI.
bilingual.zh: 在那之前，我邀请你思考一个问题：回到 2022 年，你的队友们当时会做哪些任务？那些任务很可能是你所做工作的互补项。所以，如果你能用 AI 自己把那些任务也做了——这可能需要学习新技能——这或许就是你借 AI 变得更高效的一条路径。

quotes.en: Just as AI is turning many specialized developers into full-stack developers, I am seeing early signs that it is turning many more marketers into full-stack marketers.
quotes.zh: 正如 AI 正在把许多专精开发者变成全栈开发者，我看到早期迹象：它正在把更多营销人变成「全栈营销人」。

quotes.en: As you rise in seniority, you become better at managing integration complexity — weaving together many disparate work streams to form a greater whole.
quotes.zh: 随着资历上升，你会越来越擅长管理「集成复杂度」——把许多分散的工作流编织成一个更大的整体。

quotes.en: Analyses by even frontier models are frequently wrong. So do use AI to help with your data-science tasks, but don't blindly trust its confidently stated conclusions!
quotes.zh: 即便是前沿模型做的分析也经常出错。尽管用 AI 辅助你的数据科学任务，但不要盲信它自信满满给出的结论！
